products.title: Afnan Supremacy Collectors Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is a modern, fresh, and classy men’s fragrance that brings confidence with every spray. Inspired by timeless elegance, this scent mixes fruity freshness with warm woody notes, making it perfect for the man who wants to stand out.

The first spray greets you with a burst of juicy pineapple, crisp apple, and fresh bergamot balanced with delicate white flowers. As it settles, you’ll notice the heart of orange blossom, smooth birch, and warm amber adding depth and richness. The dry-down is where Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum shines earthy oak moss, clean musk, and unique ambergris, leaving a long-lasting, masculine trail that people won’t forget.

Whether you’re dressing up for a special event or adding a touch of class to your daily look, Afnan Supremacy Collector’s Edition Eau de Parfum is your perfect companion.

products.title: Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Mancera Cedrat Boise Eau De Parfum is a bright, fresh, and modern unisex fragrance that mixes juicy citrus with smooth woods and soft musk. Inspired by sunny days and easy elegance, this perfume opens with a splash of zesty Sicilian lemon, refreshing bergamot, and a hint of spicy black currant. As it settles, fruity notes blend with soft jasmine and earthy patchouli leaf, adding depth and charm. The dry-down is warm and creamy with cedar, leather, vanilla, and white musk that stay on your skin for hours.

Mancera Cedrat Boise is a perfect everyday fragrance for people who love fresh, energetic scents with a classy twist. It feels youthful yet sophisticated, making it a favourite for both men and women who want to smell fresh, clean, and stylish all day long.

products.title: Ajmal Kuro Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Kuro is designed for the modern Indian gent who wants the punch of a designer perfume without the designer price tag. The first spray bursts open with cool bergamot and lively pepper, giving a crisp “wake‑up” feel that cuts through humidity. Just seconds later, elegant French lavender and bright geranium step in, smoothing the edges and adding a clean, shirt‑fresh vibe. Deeper down, earthy vetiver, patchouli, and a whisper of ambergris ground the scent and help it cling to skin and fabric long after sundown. Think of it as a confident handshake that turns into an all‑day friendship, easy to like, hard to forget, and perfect for the office, college campus, or a late‑night drive.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Reserve Privee Eau de Parfum is an appealing, sophisticated, and intense fragrance that is suitable for men during the evening. The top note is a soft and smooth burst of bergamot which is quickly replaced by the combination of creamy and powdery iris note alongside roasted chestnut in the heart. The base note consists of the likes of whiskey, wood, and amber which makes the overall feel sweet, boozy, and warm. The scent gives out luxury, elegance, and romance. Besides, it is an ideal fragrance for the cold nights, dinners, dates, and other romantic occasions.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum is a strong and sweet scent for men that gives a feeling of luxury and elegance. The spicy opening with cumin and cardamom is rich and a bit refreshing at the same time. Little by little, the gentle rose and powdery orris appear and smoothen out the fragrance. Finally, vanilla, amber, and woods create a soft and very persistent end. This perfume is strong, masculine, and an ideal choice for the self-assured man.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum is a bold leather perfume for men launched in 2020 by the house of Afnan Perfumes. It carries a strong masculine edge with an elegant combination of spicy, floral, woody and smoky accords. The opening is sharp and intense with leather, violet leaf, nutmeg and cinnamon. The middle brings floral tones of violet and rose combined with deep oud and cedar wood. The dry down is warm, earthy and rich with vetiver, sandalwood and amber giving it a timeless Arabic touch.

products.title: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Goddess Intense Perfume for Women by Burberry is the brand’s standout oriental gourmand fragrance, launched in 2024. The scent has a rich and sweet aroma of a quartet of vanillas and lavender, making it perfect for those who love sophistication. The fragrance is also renowned for being a more intense interpretation of Burberry Goddess EDP, with the earthy accords giving it a more warmer, woodier and long-lasting profile.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum is a bold, aromatic fragrance made for men who love rich, smoky, and spicy scents. This perfume mixes fresh herbs, warm spices, deep resins, and dark woods to create a unique scent that feels powerful and masculine.

Inspired by the mystery of smoky incense burning in a grand hall, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum wraps you in layers of fresh bergamot, spicy oregano, and herbal notes. As it settles, the heart opens with opoponax, warm amber, and labdanum that add a smooth sweetness. Finally, the base brings strong smoky notes, oud, leather, and earthy patchouli that stay on your skin for hours.

If you want to stand out at any party, wedding, or special dinner, Afnan Supremacy Incense Eau de Parfum will make sure you get noticed for your bold and classy taste.

products.title: Bvlgari Wood Essence Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Bvlgari Man Wood Essence Eau de Parfum is a bold, refreshing, and modern fragrance crafted for the urban man who never loses his connection to nature. It beautifully blends strong woody notes with fresh citrus and earthy green tones, making it perfect for men who are grounded yet ambitious.

Inspired by the harmony between nature and city life, Bvlgari Man Wood Essence gives off the feeling of a calm forest breeze in the middle of a city. It’s rich, smooth, and vibrant, a perfect choice for men who want their fragrance to be fresh but also deep and masculine.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Bad Boy Extreme Eau De Parfum is a bold oriental-woody fragrance made for men who love strong, deep, and daring scents. Launched in 2022, this perfume mixes fiery spices, rich cacao, earthy patchouli, and smoky incense into a daring yet classy blend. The fragrance opens with sharp freshness from bergamot and ginger, quickly moving into warm plum, clary sage, and exotic davana at the heart. The dry down is rich and intense with tonka bean, cacao, labdanum, patchouli, incense, and vetiver, leaving a lasting powerful trail.

products.title: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Tag Him Eau de Parfum is a men’s fragrance from the house of Armaf. It carries a strong woody spicy DNA that combines fresh citrus and spicy notes with warm woody accords. The opening comes alive with grapefruit, lemon, bergamot, and pink pepper, leading into a spicy heart of ginger, mint, lavender, and nutmeg. The scent finishes with earthy and deep base notes of vetiver, patchouli, sandalwood, and cedar. The combination is modern, youthful, and designed for men who enjoy energy and confidence in their fragrance.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Meteore Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Météore Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bright citrus perfume for men who like clean and powerful scents. The opening is full of juicy mandarin, Sicilian orange, and Calabrian bergamot, which is very sharp and fresh. The middle part of the perfume takes in Tunisian neroli along with spicy pink pepper, nutmeg, pepper, and cardamom that provide a warm spice kick. The base mostly consists of Java vetiver oil, which offers a clean, earthy aura and helps the fragrance to last on the skin.

products.title: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Davidoff Cool Water Man Reborn Eau de Parfum is a fresh, modern version of the classic Cool Water scent. It combines nature and strength with a clean, green and bold feel. The perfume starts with cool notes of galbanum and rosemary, giving a fresh and natural vibe. As it settles, Haitian vetiver adds a warm, earthy touch that feels smooth and lasting. Simple yet confident, this is the perfect perfume for men who like to feel refreshed, energetic and alive every day.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Profondo Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Giò Profondo Parfum for men is a fresh and deep ocean-inspired scent that starts with cool marine notes and bright green mandarin, moves to a soft mimosa heart, and ends with earthy patchouli and warm labdanum base. Created in 2024, it's part of the famous Acqua di Giò line, loved for its clean, lasting vibe that feels like a dive into clear blue waters. Many in the fragrance world call it a top pick for its smooth mix of notes, good throw, and easy wear that stands out without being too much.

products.title: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Indian Sandalwood Eau de Parfum is a classic woody fragrance for men. Launched in 2019, it opens with fresh and slightly sweet notes of carrot and bergamot (top notes); moves to a soft and earthy heart of orris and moss (middle notes); and rests on a warm, comforting base of Indian sandalwood, patchouli and cypriol oil (nagarmotha). It is a smooth, elegant scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Lattafa Al Qiam Silver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Al Qiam Eau de Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that feels clean, woody, and modern. It opens with a burst of grapefruit and ginger, which gives a bright and spicy freshness. After that, the heart of the perfume is made by ambroxan and sandalwood, giving a slightly warm and soft woody smell. The base consists of musk and vetiver, which produce a warm and earthy dry down that is very close to your skin. It is fresh but deep, ideal for everyday use or special occasions.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is a warm, bold, and luxurious unisex fragrance that blends rich spices with smooth oud and sweet undertones. Launched in 2021, Supremacy in Oud quickly became popular for its exotic vibe and modern twist on classic oriental scents.

The first spray of Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum brings a burst of spicy saffron and nutmeg, balanced with calming lavender. The heart reveals deep agarwood (oud) mixed with sweet notes that add a smooth, comforting layer. The dry down is warm and long-lasting with earthy patchouli and soft musk, giving this perfume a rich, lasting finish.

Afnan Supremacy in Oud Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love powerful, spicy, and woody scents that make them stand out wherever they go.

products.title: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum is a soft, earthy floral fragrance inspired by Japanese culture and Ikebana, the art of flower arranging. Created by perfumer Alexandra Carlin, it blends the fresh, slightly sweet aroma of Turkish rose with earthy beetroot and deep smoky vetiver, balanced with a layer of incense. It's a calm, minimal, and artistic scent almost meditative in its personality, perfect for those who enjoy quiet elegance and nature-inspired perfumes.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ard Al Zaafaran Dirham Oud Eau De Parfum special fragrance is perfect for both men and women who love a warm, woody scent with a touch of elegance. Dirham Oud is a beautiful combination of fresh notes and deep, earthy tones, creating a perfume that feels both modern and classic.

This fragrance is a journey for your senses. It starts with a bright and zesty burst of fruits, then moves to a soft floral heart, and finally settles into a powerful, lasting base of woods and oud. It's a scent that makes you feel confident and sophisticated, perfect for any occasion where you want to make a statement.

products.title: Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum is an intense, sensual, and elegant fragrance that captures the essence of a rainy evening in London. Inspired by the iconic Burberry trench coat and the beauty of blooming flowers after the rain, this perfume blends floral richness with warm, deep notes for a luxurious experience.

The fragrance opens with a burst of jasmine, creating a bright yet smooth introduction. The heart reveals the sweetness of peach and the romantic elegance of rose, while the base wraps you in warm amber and earthy patchouli.

Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum feels like slipping into a classic trench coat on a rainy night, walking through a garden filled with blossoms, and enjoying the comforting embrace of warm, golden lights. It is perfect for women who want to feel confident, feminine, and unforgettable.

products.title: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dumont Nitro Green Eau de Parfum is a fresh, green and woody scent made for men who like strong but clean fragrance. It opens with sweet notes of vanilla, saffron and jasmine that give a soft and rich start. In the heart, you get lavender, amberwood, green leaves and cedar that make it calm, smooth, and classy. The dry down is deep and earthy with violet, fir resin and cedar that stay warm on skin for hours.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein DEFY Eau de Parfum is a bold men’s fragrance that was launched in 2022 this scent brings a confident balance of fresh spice, smooth leather and earthy wood. The fragrance opens with a spark of Mandarin Orange and black pepper giving a bright yet spice start and the middle with saffiano leather and suede adding a refined and daring tone and at the base Haitian Vetiver anchors the scent with depth and power. It is made for men who like to break limits and show their fearless side.

products.title: Bentley Black Edition Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bentley For Men Black Edition Eau de Parfum is a bold and classy men’s fragrance from the luxury house of Bentley. Launched in 2018, this scent is built on an oriental spicy DNA. It opens with a fresh and slightly sweet touch of violet, tangerine, pink pepper, and nutmeg. The heart is deeper with papyrus, earthy notes, jasmine, patchouli, and a smooth sweetness. The base is warm and masculine, with atlas cedar, moss, incense, tobacco, and tonka bean creating a rich finish that stays long and feels powerful yet elegant.

products.title: Creed Viking Cologne Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Viking Cologne EDP for men is a bold and invigorating fragrance inspired by strength and adventure. It opens with fresh and zesty top notes of mandarin orange, lemon, pink pepper, and bergamot. The heart blends aromatic lavender, geranium, rosemary, sage, and nutmeg, creating a dynamic and spicy character. The base settles into warm and earthy notes of vetiver, cedar, sandalwood, olibanum, and patchouli, giving it depth and lasting power. Viking Cologne is admired in the fragrance community for its balanced blend of citrus, spices, and woods, offering good projection and longevity.

products.title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum For Women
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum for women is a modern, rich and seductive fragrance that was launched in 2021. It is a darker and more intense version of the original Euphoria. The perfume combines fruity freshness with sensual floral and woody notes, creating a bold statement for confident women. The composition opens with juicy black currant (top note), moves into exotic orchid (middle note), and dries down with deep earthy patchouli (base note).

products.title: Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Boss Bottled Elixir Eau de Parfum is a bold, magnetic, and modern fragrance for men who want to make a lasting impression. As the most intense version in the Boss Bottled line, this scent takes the iconic DNA and turns it into a richer, deeper, and more luxurious experience.

From the very first spray, Boss Bottled Elixir feels powerful yet smooth opening with the spicy freshness of cardamom and the smoky elegance of frankincense. As it develops, earthy patchouli and vetiver step in, adding depth and masculinity. Finally, warm labdanum and dry cedarwood create a strong, long-lasting base that feels sophisticated and confident.

This is not just a fragrance, Boss Bottled Elixir is a statement of strength and charisma. Whether for an important meeting, a date night, or a grand celebration, this scent makes sure all eyes are on you.

products.title: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum is a perfume for both men and women. It feels warm, a bit mysterious, and very rich when you wear it. The perfume is inspired by saffron, which is a very special spice. It has a combination of sweet, spicy, and earthy smell that make it bold but still very elegant.

The perfume start with saffron, juniper berries and fresh citrus from Chinese grapefruit, giving a spicy and bright opening. In the middle, you get soft leather and gentle black violet that add some depth and floral touch. Later it settle down into raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver, which give a woody, musky and little sweet finish that stay for long.

products.title: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Tobacco Eau De Parfum is a robust, warm fragrance that feels incredibly cozy and almost addictive. It opens with a smooth blend of tobacco, juicy plum, and spicy ginger, leading to a smoky yet fruity beginning. As the fragrance evolves, you find a rich heart of cloves, creamy tonka bean, and dry cedarwood that adds a depth of richness and texture. The base wraps itself in warm vanilla, benzoin, and earthy vetiver and leaves a soft sweetness with just a gentle smokiness after the dry down.

products.title: Nusuk Fawah Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Fawah Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume made for men who like strong yet fresh scents was launched in 2023. It opens with bright citrus and lavender notes, which feel clean and energetic. The middle comes with earthy patchouli, apple and a light smoky touch that gives depth. The base settles into a warm mix of vanilla, vetiver and lavender, making it smooth and slightly sweet.

products.title: Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean, and sophisticated fragrance that captures the green spirit of nature with a luxurious twist. Unlike traditional vetiver scents that use only the root, Creed uses the entire vetiver plant, leaves, roots, and heartwood, resulting in a smooth, earthy, and uplifting scent.

This unisex fragrance feels elegant yet sporty, perfect for people who love refreshing yet long-lasting perfumes. It opens with a crisp green burst and gradually melts into warm, woody softness. Creed Original Vetiver is ideal for anyone who wants to smell fresh, refined, and put-together throughout the day.

products.title: Men Office Discovery Set - Montblanc Explorer, Prada L'homme, Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver
products.body_html:
Elevate your professional presence with our Men Office Discovery Set, featuring three premium fragrances:

  • Montblanc Explorer EDP: Embrace adventure with this bold, woody scent that exudes confidence and determination.
  • Prada L'Homme EDT: Experience refined elegance with a sophisticated blend of floral and amber notes, perfect for the modern gentleman.
  • Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver EDP: Discover a fresh, earthy fragrance that combines vetiver with spicy and citrus undertones, ideal for making a lasting impression.

Perfectly curated for the modern professional, these scents embody elegance and confidence, making every day at the office exceptional.

products.title: Bdk Gris Charnel Extrait
products.body_html: BDK Gris Charnel Extrait Eau de Parfum is a bold and sensual fragrance from the French niche house BDK Parfums. Launched in 2022, this extrait version is a darker and richer twist on the original Gris Charnel. It blends spicy cardamom, sweet fig, and smoky black tea (top notes); powdery iris, earthy vetiver, and warm cistus (heart notes); and a deep base of sandalwood, patchouli, vanilla, tonka bean, and cedar. The result is a sophisticated unisex scent that feels both modern and timeless.

products.title: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Floraiku Between Two Trees Eau de Parfum feels like a quiet walk in nature on a fresh morning. It opens with the lively brightness of Grapefruit, giving a burst of energy that feels crisp and light. The scent slowly moves into the green heart of Mate, which adds a calm, earthy tone that feels warm and slightly smoky. The final note is woody and grounded, leaving behind a nice and clean trail of timeless fragrance. It is a perfect fit for someone looking for a gentle yet expressive fragrance. It gives off a fresh and outdoor-like feel, and is apt to wear at any occasion at any time of the day.

products.title: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum is an enticingly intense, blistering scent. It has that rich, sweet, luxurious feeling. It opens up with caramel, red berries, bitter orange, and tobacco; and feels creamy, smokey, and somehow fruity. The heart has tuberose, orchid, and lily, which creates a soft, weighty floral accord. In the base, monoi oil, vanilla, and patchouli develop warm, deep qualities. It has a definite presence, is fun yet very classy. There is sweet quality here, but also an earthy balance. It is a great fragrance for anyone into heavier, richer fragrances that last.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume with a fresh, woody, and spicy character. Launched in 2017, it combines bright citrus, warm spices, and earthy woody notes into a smooth and elegant composition. The perfume opens with fresh top notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper, moves into a spicy and floral heart of neroli, nutmeg, and cardamom, and finally settles into a grounding base of vetiver and woody notes. It is a versatile scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Riiffs Surge & Spectra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs R Spectra Eau dePerfum is an assertive and hot fragrance that is both hot and somewhat sweet to the touch of the man. It has a combination of orange blossom and white pepper as the beginning, which makes it fresh and sharp. As it subsides, you have warm violet, nutmeg and sweetness. Amber, vanilla bean and patchouli provide a rich, smooth and extended low in the dry down. It is contemporary, masculine, and suitable for those men who use oriental spicy perfumes that are very rich.
